evals.prompt: im building an electron app called Ledgerline, it's a personal budgeting tool that tracks accounts over time (double-entry style). can you design the app icon for it? brand color is indigo, the ui is dark. i need everything the app will use: mac icns, windows ico, a big linux png, and some small-size previews so i can check it's still legible tiny.
evals.expected_output: A concept-driven geometric icon: master SVG (no filters, ~22.5% corner radius), valid 10-entry icns with Apple margin, 6-frame ico, 1024 png, small-size previews, and evidence of variant comparison.
assertions: Master SVG file exists and contains no SVG filter primitives (no feGaussianBlur, feDropShadow, or filter elements)
Rounded-tile corner radius is between 20% and 24% of the canvas edge
A valid icon.icns is produced containing all ten standard iconset entries
The icns artwork has the Apple margin: the outer ~5% border of the largest icns entry is fully transparent
icon.ico contains the frames 256, 128, 64, 48, 32, and 16
Small-size preview renders at 64px or below exist among the outputs
At least two design variants or a side-by-side comparison sheet were produced

evals.prompt: my uptime monitoring saas is called Driftwatch. the landing page needs a real favicon setup: svg favicon, ico fallback, apple touch icon, and pwa manifest icons (including whatever android needs for maskable). brand is amber on a dark theme. include the html head snippet i should paste in.
evals.expected_output: SVG favicon, favicon.ico (32+16), fully opaque 180x180 apple-touch-icon, 192/512 PWA icons, a maskable variant with safe-zone content, manifest JSON, and a correct HTML head snippet.
assertions: An SVG favicon is produced
favicon.ico contains 32 and 16 pixel frames
apple-touch-icon.png is exactly 180x180 and fully opaque (alpha channel absent or unused)
PWA icons at 192 and 512 pixels exist
A maskable icon variant exists and the manifest or snippet declares purpose maskable
An HTML head snippet links the SVG favicon, the ico fallback, the apple-touch-icon, and the manifest

evals.prompt: im making a habit tracker called Emberloop (electron app + companion pwa). i want an icon in a coral/ember palette. i specifically need BOTH light and dark tile variants (the app has both themes), plus a flat two-color version (single mark color on the background color) that i can use for android themed icons and stickers. show me proof it still reads at 16px and that the flat one doesn't turn to mush.
evals.expected_output: Light and dark tiles from one geometry, a two-color mono variant with weave notches at crossings, 16px legibility evidence for both full-color and flat versions.
assertions: Light and dark tile variants both exist among the outputs
Light and dark variants share identical mark geometry (only fills differ between their SVGs)
A flat mono variant SVG exists using at most two distinct fill colors
The flat variant keeps overlaps/crossings legible via background-colored gaps or merged silhouettes (visual check)
Small-size renders at 32px or below exist, including evidence for the flat variant
Tile corner radius is between 20% and 24% of the canvas edge
No SVG filter elements in any produced SVG
